deck: Nifty closed at 25,292 (▲ 0.99%) and Sensex at 82,101 (▲ 1.23%). Over the last five sessions Nifty is up 6.2%. Brent crude is near $92 a barrel and the rupee at 93.74 to the dollar.
story: Of the 80 large stocks this page tracks, 58 rose and 20 fell. BANKBARODA led the gainers (+5.27%), while NHPC fell the most (-2.39%). Bank Nifty ended ▲ 2.00%.
Across markets: Brent crude near $92 a barrel (-2.7% on the week), the rupee at 93.74 per dollar (stronger on the week), gold near $4,071 an ounce.

In the headlines: “Stock Market Today: Sensex Jumps 1,300 Points, Nifty Crosses 25,400 as Foreign Buyers Return” (The United Indian). “Oil Rises as Markets Weigh Iran War De-escalation Hopes, Hormuz Risks” (Business Post Nigeria).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 2.7% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 93.74 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
